title: [Core] GCS crash if instantiating JobSubmissionClient with invalid address
description:
What happened + What you expected to happen
When instantiating a JobSubmissionClient, if an invalid address is provided, gcs will crash the entire python interpreter and throw an error:

# all good
client = JobSubmissionClient("https://legitimate.address.com")

# not good...
client = JobSubmissionClient("foobar")

Ideally, this error should be caught at the Python level and raise an exception, alerting the user that the address is invalid. (I'm not positive what constitutes a valid vs invalid address, but in my tests "legitimate" URLs always worked and random strings never did.)

Versions / Dependencies
Ray 2.8.0
Python 3.10.6

Reproduction script
import os
from ray.job_submission import JobSubmissionClient

# RAY_ADDRESS always overrides user-provided address, so let's clear it
try:
    del(os.environ["RAY_ADDRESS"])
except KeyError:
    pass

client = JobSubmissionClient(address="foo")
# CRASH!
